```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r data}

## begin 2022 - this is a lot, but mostly renaming and combining things. original surveys were done with survey123 and produced weirdly formatted outputs which is why things are separated by plant natural history status. 

# read in raw data frames
summary_22_salvage <- read.csv("data22/data2022salvage.csv")
summary_22_salvage_native <- read.csv("data22/data2022salvage_natives.csv")
summary_22_salvage_nonnative <- read.csv("data22/data2022salvage_nonnatives.csv")
summary_22_salvage_unknown <- read.csv("data22/data2022salvage_unknown.csv")

# this basically just gets block names 
Salv_22 <- summary_22_salvage %>%
  select(GlobalID, Block.Name, Unlisted.Block, Plot.Name, Transect.Start.Time, Transect.Finish.Time, Monitor.Names) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(Block.Name = case_when(Block.Name == "UNLISTED" ~ Unlisted.Block, 
                                TRUE ~ Block.Name)) %>%
  mutate(Block.Name = str_replace_all(Block.Name, " ", "")) %>%
  mutate(Block.Name = case_when(str_starts(Block.Name, "Vege") ~ "VD", 
                                str_starts(Block.Name, "Treat") ~ "TD", 
                                str_starts(Block.Name, "vege") ~ "VD", 
                                str_starts(Block.Name, "Grass") ~ "GRASS1", 
                                TRUE ~ Block.Name)) %>%
  rename(ParentGlobalID = GlobalID) %>%
  mutate(PLOTID = paste(Block.Name, Plot.Name, sep = "_"))

#substrate
Salv_22_S <- summary_22_salvage %>%
  select(GlobalID, Block.Name, Unlisted.Block, Plot.Name, Percent.Bare.Ground.and.Thatch, Percent.Dead.Iceplant) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(Block.Name = case_when(Block.Name == "UNLISTED" ~ Unlisted.Block, 
                                TRUE ~ Block.Name)) %>%
  mutate(Block.Name = str_replace_all(Block.Name, " ", "")) %>%
  mutate(Block.Name = case_when(str_starts(Block.Name, "Vege") ~ "VD", 
                                str_starts(Block.Name, "Treat") ~ "TD", 
                                str_starts(Block.Name, "vege") ~ "VD", 
                                str_starts(Block.Name, "Grass") ~ "GRASS1", 
                                TRUE ~ Block.Name)) %>%
  rename(ParentGlobalID = GlobalID) %>%
  mutate(PLOTID = paste(Block.Name, Plot.Name, sep = "_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Percent.Bare.Ground.and.Thatch, Percent.Dead.Iceplant), names_to = "Species", values_to = "X.Cover") %>%
  mutate(Species = case_when(Species == "Percent.Bare.Ground.and.Thatch" ~ "Bare ground and thatch", 
                             T ~ "Dead iceplant")) %>%
  mutate(History = "Substrate") %>%
  select(ParentGlobalID, Species, X.Cover, History)


#native species and some renaming
Salv_22_N <- summary_22_salvage_native %>%
  select(ParentGlobalID, Native.Species, Unlisted.Native.Species, Native.Species.Percent.Cover) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(Native.Species.Percent.Cover != 0) %>%
  mutate(History = "Native") %>%
  rename(X.Cover = Native.Species.Percent.Cover) %>%
  rename(Species = Native.Species) %>%
  mutate(Species = case_when(str_starts(Unlisted.Native.Species, "TODI") ~ "Toxicodendron diversilobum", 
                             str_starts(Unlisted.Native.Species, "Gaviota") ~ "Deinandra increscens ssp. villosa", 
                             str_starts(Unlisted.Native.Species, "gaviota") ~ "Deinandra increscens ssp. villosa", 
                             str_starts(Unlisted.Native.Species, "Dein") ~ "Deinandra increscens ssp. villosa",  
                             str_starts(Unlisted.Native.Species, "Cusc") ~ "Cuscuta californica", 
                             str_starts(Unlisted.Native.Species, "Acmis") ~ "Acmispon junceaus", 
                             str_starts(Unlisted.Native.Species, "pseud") ~ "Pseudognaphalium bioletii", 
                             str_starts(Unlisted.Native.Species, "Eriop") ~ "Eriophyllum staechadifolium", 
                             str_starts(Unlisted.Native.Species, "Dudl") ~ "Dudleya sp.", 
                             str_starts(Unlisted.Native.Species, "dein") ~ "Deinandra increscens ssp. villosa",
                             TRUE ~ Species)) %>%
  select(-Unlisted.Native.Species) %>%
  distinct()

#nonnative species and renaming
Salv_22_NN <- summary_22_salvage_nonnative %>%
  select(ParentGlobalID, Non_Native.Species, Unlisted.Non.Native.Species, Non.Native.Species.Percent.Cover) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(Non.Native.Species.Percent.Cover != 0) %>%
  mutate(History = "Nonnative") %>%
  rename(X.Cover = Non.Native.Species.Percent.Cover) %>%
  rename(Species = Non_Native.Species) %>%
  mutate(Species = case_when(str_starts(Unlisted.Non.Native.Species, "Star") ~ "Centaurea melitensis", 
                             str_starts(Unlisted.Non.Native.Species, "Erh") ~ "Ehrharta calycina", 
                             str_starts(Unlisted.Non.Native.Species, "Cent") ~ "Centaurea melitensis", 
                             TRUE ~ Species)) %>%
  select(-Unlisted.Non.Native.Species) %>%
  distinct()

#species that were unknown at the time of surveying. I looked back and renamed these to represent true IDs
Salv_22_Unk <- summary_22_salvage_unknown %>%
  select(ParentGlobalID, Unknown.Species.Description, Unknown.Species.Percent.Cover) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(Unknown.Species.Percent.Cover != 0) %>%
  rename(X.Cover = Unknown.Species.Percent.Cover) %>%
  rename(Species = Unknown.Species.Description) %>%
  mutate(History = case_when(Species == "Eriophyllum staechadifolium" | Species == "Daucus pusillus" | 
                               Species == "Corethrogyne filaginifolia" | Species == "Cardionema ramosissimum" | 
                               Species == "Pseudognaphalium beneolens" | Species == "Stephanomeria virgata" ~ "Native", 
                             TRUE ~ "Nonnative")) %>%
  filter(Species != "UNKNOWN")

#combining dfs
Salv_22_full <- merge(Salv_22_N, Salv_22_NN, all = T)
Salv_22_full <- merge(Salv_22_full, Salv_22_Unk, all = T)
Salv_22_full <- merge(Salv_22_full, Salv_22_S, all = T)

Salv_22_full <- Salv_22_full %>%
  left_join(Salv_22) %>%
  select(-Unlisted.Block)


# repeat above for 2nd survey format

summary_22_salvage_B <- read.csv("data22/data2022salvageB.csv")
summary_22_salvage_native_B <- read.csv("data22/data2022salvageB_natives.csv")
summary_22_salvage_nonnative_B <- read.csv("data22/data2022salvageB_nonnatives.csv")
summary_22_salvage_unknown_B <- read.csv("data22/data2022salvageB_unknown.csv")

Salv_22_B <- summary_22_salvage_B %>%
  select(GlobalID, Block.Name, Plot.Name, Transect.Start.Time, Transect.Finish.Time, Monitor.Names) %>%
  distinct()  %>%
  mutate(Block.Name = str_replace_all(Block.Name, " ", "")) %>%
  rename(ParentGlobalID = GlobalID) %>%
  mutate(PLOTID = paste(Block.Name, Plot.Name, sep = "_"))

Salv_22_S_B <- summary_22_salvage_B %>%
  select(GlobalID, Block.Name, Unlisted.Block, Plot.Name, Bare.Ground, Percent.Dead.Iceplant) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(Block.Name = case_when(Block.Name == "UNLISTED" ~ Unlisted.Block, 
                                TRUE ~ Block.Name)) %>%
  mutate(Block.Name = str_replace_all(Block.Name, " ", "")) %>%
  mutate(Block.Name = case_when(str_starts(Block.Name, "Vege") ~ "VD", 
                                str_starts(Block.Name, "Treat") ~ "TD", 
                                str_starts(Block.Name, "vege") ~ "VD", 
                                str_starts(Block.Name, "Grass") ~ "GRASS1", 
                                TRUE ~ Block.Name)) %>%
  rename(ParentGlobalID = GlobalID) %>%
  mutate(PLOTID = paste(Block.Name, Plot.Name, sep = "_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Bare.Ground, Percent.Dead.Iceplant), names_to = "Species", values_to = "X.Cover") %>%
  mutate(Species = case_when(Species == "Bare.Ground" ~ "Bare ground and thatch", 
                             T ~ "Dead iceplant")) %>%
  mutate(History = "Substrate") %>%
  select(ParentGlobalID, Species, X.Cover, History)

Salv_22_N_B <- summary_22_salvage_native_B %>%
  select(ParentGlobalID, Native.Species, Unlisted.Native.Species, Native.Species.Percent.Cover) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(Native.Species.Percent.Cover != 0) %>%
  mutate(History = "Native") %>%
  rename(X.Cover = Native.Species.Percent.Cover) %>%
  rename(Species = Native.Species) %>%
  mutate(Species = case_when(str_starts(Unlisted.Native.Species, "Dein") ~ "Deinandra increscens ssp. villosa", 
                             str_starts(Unlisted.Native.Species, "Acmi") ~ "Acmispon strigosus",
                             TRUE ~ Species)) %>%
  select(-Unlisted.Native.Species) %>%
  distinct()

Salv_22_NN_B <- summary_22_salvage_nonnative_B %>%
  select(ParentGlobalID, Non_Native.Species, Non.Native.Species.Percent.Cover) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(Non.Native.Species.Percent.Cover != 0) %>%
  mutate(History = "Nonnative") %>%
  rename(X.Cover = Non.Native.Species.Percent.Cover) %>%
  rename(Species = Non_Native.Species) %>%
  distinct()

Salv_22_Unk_B <- summary_22_salvage_unknown_B %>%
  select(ParentGlobalID, Unknown.Species.Description, Unknown.Species.Percent.Cover) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(Unknown.Species.Percent.Cover != 0) %>%
  rename(X.Cover = Unknown.Species.Percent.Cover) %>%
  rename(Species = Unknown.Species.Description) %>%
  mutate(History = "Native")

Salv_22_full_B <- merge(Salv_22_N_B, Salv_22_NN_B, all = T)
Salv_22_full_B <- merge(Salv_22_full_B, Salv_22_Unk_B, all = T)
Salv_22_full_B <- merge(Salv_22_full_B, Salv_22_S_B, all = T)

Salv_22_full_B <- Salv_22_full_B %>%
  left_join(Salv_22_B)

#final combination
Salv_22_full_final <- merge(Salv_22_full, Salv_22_full_B, all = T)

#making sure spelling and names match future formatting
data_22_full_final <- Salv_22_full_final %>%
  mutate(Species = str_replace(Species, "_", " ")) %>%
  mutate(Species = case_when(Species == "Acimispon glabor" ~ "Acmispon glaber", 
                             Species == "Calystegia macrostegia_cyclos." ~ "Calystegia macrostegia", 
                             Species == "Sonchus sp" ~ "Sonchus spp.", 
                             Species == "Sonchus asper" ~ "Sonchus spp.", 
                             Species == "Spergularia sp" ~ "Spergularia spp.", 
                             Species == "Centaurium sp." ~ "Centaurea melitensis", 
                             Species == "Abronia maritima" ~ "Abronia umbellata", 
                             Species == "Acimispon maritimus" ~ "Acmispon strigosus", 
                             Species == "Acimispon strigosus" ~ "Acmispon strigosus", 
                             Species == "Avena barbata" ~ "Avena spp.", 
                             Species == "Avena fatua" ~ "Avena spp.", 
                             Species == "Carpobrotus chilensis" ~ "Carpobrotus edulis", 
                             Species == "Cuscuta salina" ~ "Cuscuta californica", 
                             Species == "ehrharta calycina" ~ "Ehrharta calycina", 
                             Species == "Eriogonum fasciculatum" ~ "Eriogonum parvifolium", 
                             Species == "Erodium cicutarium" ~ "Erodium spp.", 
                             Species == "Erodium botrys" ~ "Erodium spp.", 
                             Species == "Hordeum brachyantherum_calif." ~ "Hordeum brachyantherum", 
                             Species == "Hordeum marinum" ~ "Hordeum murinum", 
                             Species == "Hypochaeris radicata" ~ "Hypochaeris glabra", 
                             Species == "Sonchus oleraceus" ~ "Sonchus spp.", 
                             Species == "Spergularia sp." ~ "Spergularia spp.", 
                             Species == "unlisted" ~ "UNKNOWN", 
                             TRUE ~ Species)) %>%
  filter(Species != "UNKNOWN") %>%
  select(-c(ParentGlobalID, Transect.Start.Time, Transect.Finish.Time, Monitor.Names))

## end 2022

## begin 2023

data2023 <- read.csv("data23/2023_veg_data.csv")
specieslist2023 <- read.csv("data23/specieslist.csv")
subplots2023 <- read.csv("data23/subplots.csv")

#rename column 2
colnames(data2023)[2] = "Subplot"

#remove data_type column
data2023 <- data2023[, -5]

#replace missing erigeron cover
data2023 <- data2023 %>% replace_na(list(X.Cover = 1))

#left join data frames to create data_type column
data2023 <- merge(x = data2023, y = specieslist2023, all.x = TRUE)

data2023 <- data2023 %>% 
  mutate(Data.type = case_when(
    startsWith(data2023$Data.type, "Non") ~ "Nonnative",
    startsWith(data2023$Data.type, "Substrate") ~ "Substrate",
    startsWith(data2023$Data.type, "Native") ~ "Native"))

# end 23

#begin 24

data24 <- read.csv("data24/data2024.csv")
plotinfo24 <- read.csv("data24/plotinfo2024.csv")
species24 <- read.csv("data24/species24.csv")

#contains unknowns
data24 <- data24 %>%
  mutate(STRIP = replace_na(STRIP, "Control"))

data_plots <- data24 %>%
  left_join(plotinfo24, by = c("Block_Name", "Subplot", "STRIP")) 

species24 <- species24 %>%
  rename(Substrate.Species = Latin)

plotinfo24 <- plotinfo24 %>%
  mutate(STRIP = replace_na(STRIP, "Control"))

# end 24

# begin 2025

species25 <- read.csv("data25/species25.csv")

# end 25

# begin 2026

data26 <- read.csv("data26/data26.csv")
species26 <- read.csv("data26/Species26.csv") %>%

# create single data frame across years for high native and pockmark blocks. i cannot include strip blocks because of sampling differences. i do not need dune or wetland data for this chapter. 


NP_P_22 <- data_22_full_final %>%
  select(Species, X.Cover, Block.Name, Plot.Name) %>%
  rename(Block_Name = Block.Name) %>%
  rename(Subplot = Plot.Name) %>%
  mutate(Year = "2022") %>%
  left_join(plotinfo25) %>%
  filter(Block_Type == "Pock" | Block_Type == "High Native") %>%
  group_by(Year, Block_Name, Subplot) %>%
  mutate(Total_Cover = sum(X.Cover)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(Total_Cover > 99) #this removes ADLP1_4B because cover is only 73...data error

NP_P_23 <- data2023 %>%
  select(Substrate.Species, X.Cover, Block_Name, Subplot) %>%
  rename(Species = Substrate.Species) %>%
  mutate(Year = "2023") %>%
  left_join(plotinfo25) %>%
  filter(Block_Type == "Pock" | Block_Type == "High Native") %>%
  group_by(Year, Block_Name, Subplot) %>%
  mutate(Total_Cover = sum(X.Cover)) %>%
  ungroup()

NP_P_24 <- data24 %>%
  select(Substrate.Species, X.Cover, Block_Name, Subplot) %>%
  rename(Species = Substrate.Species) %>%
  mutate(Year = "2024") %>%
  left_join(plotinfo25) %>%
  filter(Block_Type == "Pock" | Block_Type == "High Native") %>%
  mutate(Species = case_when(Species == "Bare ground - gopher" ~ "Bare ground", T ~ Species)) %>%
  group_by(Block_Name, Subplot, Species) %>%
  mutate(X.Cover = sum(X.Cover)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(Year, Block_Name, Subplot) %>%
  mutate(Total_Cover = sum(X.Cover)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(Total_Cover > 99) #this removes SLP1_1B because cover is only 87...data error
  
NP_P_25 <- data_1percent %>%
  select(Latin, Cover, Block_Name, Subplot) %>%
  rename(Species = Latin) %>%
  rename(X.Cover = Cover) %>%
  mutate(Year = "2025") %>%
  left_join(plotinfo25) %>%
  filter(Block_Type == "Pock" | Block_Type == "High Native") %>%
  group_by(Year, Block_Name, Subplot) %>%
  mutate(Total_Cover = sum(X.Cover)) %>%
  ungroup()

NP_P_26 <- data26 %>%
  select(Latin, Cover, Block_Name, Subplot, STRIP) %>%
  filter(STRIP != "L") %>%
  filter(STRIP != "R") %>%
  select(-STRIP) %>%
  rename(Species = Latin) %>%
  rename(X.Cover = Cover) %>%
  mutate(Year = "2026") %>%
  left_join(plotinfo25) %>%
  filter(Block_Type == "Pock" | Block_Type == "High Native")  %>%
  group_by(Year, Block_Name, Subplot) %>%
  mutate(Total_Cover = sum(X.Cover)) %>%
  ungroup()

NP_P_all_years <- merge(NP_P_22, NP_P_23, all = T)
NP_P_all_years <- merge(NP_P_all_years, NP_P_24, all = T)
NP_P_all_years <- merge(NP_P_all_years, NP_P_25, all = T)
NP_P_all_years <- merge(NP_P_all_years, NP_P_26, all = T)

NP_P_all_years_final <- NP_P_all_years %>%

                             Species == "bare ground" ~ "Bare ground and thatch",

#create species data frame which can be used for iceplant cover

species_df <- NP_P_all_years_final %>%
  select(-Total_Cover) %>%
  complete(Species, nesting(Block_Type, Block_Name, Subplot, Year, Primary_Treat, Secondary_Treat, Native_Treat, SOIL, WIND, NOTES), fill = list(X.Cover = 0)) %>%
  group_by(Year, Block_Name, Subplot) %>%
  mutate(Total_Cover = sum(X.Cover)) %>%
  ungroup()

# thinking i could break here or above and keep as separate script for data cleaning...

iceplant_df <- species_df %>%
  filter(Species == "Carpobrotus edulis") %>%
  mutate(Cover_Decimal = X.Cover/100 + 0.00001) %>% #beta dist. needs values between 0 and 1
  filter(Primary_Treat != "NONE") %>% #remove control plots...not needed for reinvasion
  mutate(Baseline_Condition = case_when(Block_Type == "Pock" ~ "Inv.", 
                                        T ~ "Rem.")) %>%
  mutate(IP_Treatment = case_when(Secondary_Treat == "NONE" ~ "No_Retrt.", 
                                        T ~ "Retrt.")) %>%  
  mutate(Site = paste(SOIL, WIND)) %>%
  mutate(CondXtreat = paste(Baseline_Condition, IP_Treatment, sep = "x")) %>%
  mutate(Block_Type = factor(Block_Type)) %>%
  mutate(Block_Name = factor(Block_Name)) %>%
  mutate(Subplot = factor(Subplot)) %>%
  mutate(Year = factor(Year)) %>%
  mutate(Primary_Treat = factor(Primary_Treat)) %>%
  mutate(Secondary_Treat = factor(Secondary_Treat)) %>%
  mutate(Native_Treat = factor(Native_Treat)) %>%
  mutate(SOIL = factor(SOIL)) %>%
  mutate(WIND = factor(WIND)) %>%
  mutate(Site = factor(Site)) %>%
  mutate(Baseline_Condition = factor(Baseline_Condition, levels = c("Inv.", "Rem."))) %>%
  mutate(IP_Treatment = factor(IP_Treatment, levels = c("Retrt.", "No_Retrt.")))

```

```{r reinvasion analysis}
#why do this? check back and note why....

contrasts(iceplant_df$Baseline_Condition) <- contr.sum
contrasts(iceplant_df$IP_Treatment) <- contr.sum
contrasts(iceplant_df$Native_Treat) <- contr.sum

model_b_disp<- glmmTMB(Cover_Decimal ~ Year*Baseline_Condition*IP_Treatment + Native_Treat + (1|Site/Block_Name/Subplot), data = iceplant_df, family = beta_family(link = "logit"), dispformula = ~ Year*Baseline_Condition*IP_Treatment + Native_Treat)

performance::check_model(model_b_disp)
plot(simulateResiduals(model_b_disp))
car::qqPlot(residuals(model_b_disp))
car::Anova(model_b_disp, type = "III")

emm_b_disp <- pairs(emmeans::emmeans(model_b_disp, ~ Baseline_Condition | IP_Treatment * Year, type = "response"), by = "Year",  adjust = "tukey", type = "response")
summary(emm_b_disp)

emm_b_stats <- as.data.frame(emmeans::emmeans(model_b_disp, specs = "Baseline_Condition", by = c("IP_Treatment", "Year"))) %>%
  mutate(CondXtreat = paste(Baseline_Condition, IP_Treatment, sep = "x")) 

emm_b_plot <- as.data.frame(emmeans::emmeans(model_b_disp, specs = "Baseline_Condition", by = c("IP_Treatment", "Year"), type = "response")) %>%
  mutate(CondXtreat = paste(Baseline_Condition, IP_Treatment, sep = "x")) 
```

```{r reinvasion figure}

IP_Reionvasion_BetaDis <- ggboxplot(iceplant_df, "Year", "Cover_Decimal", fill = "CondXtreat", add = c("jitter"), add.params = list(alpha = 0.2, color = "CondXtreat"), palette = c("forestgreen", "lightgreen", "blue", "lightblue"), ylab = "Proportion C. edulis", alpha = 0.2, xlab = F) + theme(legend.position = c(0.33,0.84), legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent"), text = element_text(size = 10)) + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,1)) +
  geom_point(data = emm_b_plot, aes(x = Year, y=response, color = CondXtreat), size =3, position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    data = emm_b_plot,
    aes(Year, response, ymin = response - SE, ymax = response + SE, color = CondXtreat), position = position_dodge(0.8),
    width = .2
  ) + geom_vline(xintercept = 1.5, linetype = "dashed") 

IP_Reionvasion_BetaDis <- ggpar(IP_Reionvasion_BetaDis, legend.title = "Baseline Condition x\n Iceplant Treatment")

IP_Reionvasion_BetaDis
ggsave("figs/IP_Reionvasion_BetaDis.png", IP_Reionvasion_BetaDis, dpi = 300, width = 6.5, height = 4)
```

```{r native vs reinvasion}
#eventually make a new rmd file for this 
species_info_df <- read.csv("NP_P_Species.csv")


native_v_ip_df <- species_df %>%
  left_join(species_info_df) %>%
  filter(Status == "Native" | Status == "CAED") %>%
  group_by(Year, Block_Name, Subplot, Status) %>%
  mutate(Group_Cover = sum(X.Cover)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Year, Block_Type, Block_Name, Subplot, Status, Group_Cover, Primary_Treat, Secondary_Treat, Native_Treat, SOIL, WIND, NOTES) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "Status", values_from = "Group_Cover") %>%
  filter(Block_Type == "Pock") %>%
  filter(Secondary_Treat == "NONE") %>%
  filter(Year == "2025" | Year == "2026") %>%
  mutate(Site = paste(SOIL, WIND))

lm <- glmmTMB(CAED ~ Native*Year + Native_Treat + (1|Site/Block_Name/Subplot), data =  native_v_ip_df)
summary(lm)

car::Anova(lm, type = "II")

ggscatter(native_v_ip_df, "Native", "CAED", facet.by = "Year", add = "reg.line", conf.int = T, cor.coef = T) 

```
